title: General Pest Control
description: Comprehensive defense against common household pests including ants, spiders, crickets, and silverfish across Huntington Beach properties.

title: Residential Pest Control
description: Customized home perimeter treatments, attic inspections, and targeted interior defense designed for Huntington Beach homeowners.

title: Commercial Pest Control
description: Discreet, health-code-compliant pest management programs for restaurants, retail storefronts, and commercial facilities throughout Orange County.

title: Termite Control
description: Advanced detection and treatment for Western drywood and subterranean termites, including localized spot treatments and structural defense.

title: Rodent Control
description: Targeted trapping, attic sanitization, and habitat remediation to eliminate roof rats and mice from coastal Orange County structures.

title: Cockroach Control
description: Precision baiting, insect growth regulators, and flush treatments to eradicate persistent German and Oriental cockroach infestations.

title: Ant Control
description: Colony-transfer baits and non-repellent perimeter barriers engineered specifically to conquer massive Argentine ant supercolonies.

title: Bed Bug Treatment
description: Multi-stage thermal and targeted chemical remediation protocols to eliminate bed bug adults, nymphs, and eggs from mattresses and wall voids.

title: Mosquito Control
description: Targeted foliage misting, standing water larviciding, and breeding source reduction for properties near Bolsa Chica and coastal canals.

title: Spider Control
description: De-webbing sweeps, perimeter barrier treatments, and harbor reduction for Western black widows and brown widow spiders.

title: Wasp Removal
description: Safe removal of paper wasp nests, yellowjacket ground colonies, and mud daubers from roof eaves, decks, and structural overhangs.

title: Flea and Tick Control
description: Dual-action outdoor turf applications and interior premise treatments to interrupt the reproductive life cycle of fleas and ticks.

title: Pest Exclusion Service
description: Physical reinforcement of foundation weep screeds, crawlspace vents, roofline gaps, and utility penetrations with chew-proof materials.

title: Pest Inspection
description: Thorough visual, acoustic, and moisture evaluation of foundation sill plates, attics, sub-areas, and exterior grounds to diagnose infestations.

title: Recurring Pest Protection
description: Quarterly and bi-monthly scheduled perimeter treatments, monitoring stations, and seasonal barrier refreshes for uninterrupted defense.
